newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends steady vs basket, shade down v dlr.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends steady vs basket, shade down v dlr.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed steady against the central bank (NBH) basket on Wednesday and a shade easier against the dollar in a lively, but balanced interbank forex market, dealers said.
The forint finished at 183.75/80 against the dollar, compared with 183.60/65 at opening and 183.66/71 at midday.

"Activity was livelier than usual but it was two-sided," said Ervin Csengeri of Inter-Europa Bank. "Some banks were selling to finance deals on a busy currency futures market but there were an equal number selling."
Dealers added they expected the forint to remain within 20 pips of the resistance level as there were few domestic factors to change its level against the NBH basket
(NBH basket: 30 percent dollar, 70 percent German mark.)
